frame-light.webp.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high-end production image asset: ONE very light PALE MINT SILK scarf caught gently floating horizontally in slow air, genuine transparent RGBA background, no scene. This is for a readable livestream chat overlay, with actual text added by software. The entire scarf is ONE flowing piece of cloth with no borders, seams, outlines or frame. Its central 70 percent MUST be broad, smooth, low-contrast and fully spread open toward the camera, with generous room for TWO LINES of text, avoiding any narrow neck in the text zone. The top and bottom of that central writing area are ALMOST horizontal with only the most subtle asymmetrical organic undulation, an extremely shallow wave of no more than 5 percent of the fabric height. The centre must NOT sag into a deep U or S. At the far LEFT, just the outermost 8 percent curls back loosely, thin as a veil; at the far RIGHT, the last 15 percent of the SAME silk floats into a graceful short soft free end with a shallow flowing bend, still broad near its attachment. The motion is expressed mostly in these two free edges, not through the writing area. No rigid tab, no swallowtail cut, no geometric pointed tips. The naturally irregular edges have soft translucency and absolutely no sewn or metallic hem. Main-body silhouette is about 4:1 width to height; the whole object about 4.7:1 including short free end. Width should visually dominate. Pastel luminous mint-celadon #D7EBDD with hints of pale spring green transmitted light, soft pearl-white highlights, muted sage fold shadows; all LIGHT in value, delicate and fresh, never dark teal, never muddy or grey. Mostly opaque central silk, translucent outer edges only. Airy silk-chiffon with fine organic microtexture, photographed in soft diffuse daylight. Folds are tiny, broad, sparse and relaxed, never thick or wrinkled. Natural wind direction from left to right, the free right end follows with one soft bend. A graceful suspended scarf rather than a padded banner or plaque. Whole object completely visible, generous true transparent safety margins. No cast shadow on any background. No letters, no text, no logo, no UI, no frame, no rectangular card, no ribbons crossing over the front, no knots, no medals, no piping, no metallic trim, no heavy fabric, no inflated cushion, no plastic gloss, no jewelry, no decorative motifs, no particles, no glow, no fake checkerboard. Elegant, effortless and calm, realistic fine silk texture and illumination. Composition must prioritize the broad and very gently flowing OPEN writing area.
frame-light.webp.processing: Clean only generated alpha fringe and disconnected specks; crop (47, 164, 1871, 662); proportional resize to width 960; 24px vertical safety margins. Luminous mint color grade from the same silk artwork. Static first frame for reduced-motion preference. WebP quality 85, 960x310; original generated fabric and organic silhouette retained.

flag-tail.webp.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one SHORT elegant silk ribbon end / swallowtail flag tab, an isolated production raster illustration with genuine transparent RGBA background. The tab will protrude only 60 pixels from the right side of a 340-pixel livestream chat card; draw a COMPACT shape, roughly 1:1 width-to-height, NOT a long trail. It is a single solid piece of muted ink-teal silk, single hue palette #326C73 with deeper folds #183C43 and subtle pale-teal satin highlights. Left attachment edge is straight and vertical, extending from top to bottom; one broad softly raised fold travels through the middle of the fabric, and the right free edge ends in a short shallow V-shaped swallowtail notch with two blunt fabric tips. Air movement goes to the right while the chat card travels left. Suggest a light breeze through ONE small S-shaped fabric fold and slight asymmetry, never a spiral or multiple ribbons. Fine diagonal weave and a neatly rolled narrow hem, believable diffuse lighting, expertly hand-painted couture textile, confident subdued mature art direction. Entire object inside canvas with transparent safety margin. Shape occupies an approximately square area, broad at root, compact free end. Most fabric is opaque. No long streamers, no glow, no colored light, no particles or stars, no gemstones or pearls, no metallic outlines, no gold, no iridescence, no fantasy effects, no decorative patterns, no symbols, no text, no flagpole, no card, no backdrop, no floor shadow, no fake checkerboard. One short flag end only.
flag-tail.webp.processing: Visible-alpha (>4) bounds with 8px bleed, crop (145, 274, 1130, 940); proportional resize to 512x346; WebP quality 94; generated alpha preserved inside crop.
flag-tail.webp.usage: Legacy asset retained for existing references; current frame-light and frame-guard each include their own integral tail.

crane-top-left.webp.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production sprite atlas of FOUR separated transparent corner ornaments for a Chinese livestream danmaku banner. This is decorative UI artwork, NOT a mockup or an entire panel.
Art direction: delicate refined Chinese gongbi botanical illustration, warm champagne gold, small butter-yellow osmanthus and wildflowers, olive-gold leaves, a luminous ivory white crane, soft ivory silk mist. Subtle gold fine outlines. Elegant, airy, asymmetric. Warm pastel cream and gold, restrained green. Match a pale champagne banner with thin gold rules and a small ivory nickname plaque. Keep decorative silhouettes strong enough to be legible at 160px width.
Canvas: 1536x1024 transparent RGBA, with four fully isolated ornaments arranged in a 2 by 2 grid. Large COMPLETELY EMPTY gaps between all four cells. Each silhouette fully contained in its cell with at least 50px safety margin. No rectangular patches or backdrop; every negative space is transparent.
Upper-left cell: a sparse curved branch of elongated olive and antique-gold leaves with a few tiny yellow flowers. The stem begins near the lower-left and curves up and right, ending naturally. Gentle falling gold petals close to the branch. Horizontal corner composition, airy.
Upper-right cell: ONE graceful ivory white crane in flight, side view facing LEFT, long fine beak and elegantly curved neck, flowing extended white wings pointing right. A small cluster of yellow osmanthus flowers and olive leaves underneath its body, anchored toward the right edge. Exquisite clean feather details. Horizontal silhouette. No lantern in this cell.
Lower-left cell: a lush compact spray of warm yellow flowers, fine gold buds and broad olive leaves; curving stems gracefully emerge upward and inward (to the right). Crescent-like silhouette. Slightly denser than the upper-left ornament.
Lower-right cell: one small ivory-and-champagne Chinese hanging lantern with fine gold rim and a short delicate tassel at the RIGHT side. A few yellow flowers and olive leaves surrounding its suspension branch at upper right. A soft, flowing luminous ivory silk mist ribbon drifts leftwards along the bottom, ending in a graceful taper. Keep center open.
No text, no typography, no letters, no symbols, no panel, no border lines, no scene, no room, no furniture, no shadow plane, no checkerboard. Genuine transparent alpha background. The four ornaments must be separate and must NOT touch each other.
crane-top-left.webp.processing: Cropped each isolated ornament from its atlas cell using the generated alpha channel. Reduced saturation to 72% for the reference champagne palette and downsampled with Lanczos. No geometric background mask; native transparency preserved. Each corner follows its corresponding frame edge without stretching.
